assessments.assessment: T01-AC03/04 already require complete protected object inventory/authentication before a verified copy is published. Finite independent inspection confirms that ObjectStore accepts known object IDs, aggregate/lineage/package readers require known domain IDs, usage iterates only present files after constructing a private metadata map, reconciliation covers partial operation inventories, and database_integrity_report covers relational/cipher integrity rather than external ciphertext membership. A valid referenced row with absent ciphertext is therefore a concrete untested completeness counterexample to these existing public seams. Filename scanning cannot invert the accepted opaque physical identity. The original recovery source envelope excludes object_store.py and its public port, so a single explicit append-only owner grant is necessary before dependent edits.

The request adds one existing concrete adapter path. Complete database enumeration remains inside object_store.py, already recognized as a data adapter by the unchanged architecture checker. The already authorized project_recovery port carries typed content-free inputs/results; main.py only composes and projects.py orchestrates through that port. No public ObjectStore expansion, new adapter/module, business SQL, checker change, controller permission or false-positive exemption is requested. Existing adapter entrypoint is narrower than extending the public ObjectStore port; deferral truthfully leaves recovery completeness pending.

Verification is confined to the privately owned staged copy while the original remains held unchanged. The proposed complete canonical membership/state/identity/length/key/reference checks, safe opaque paths and full authenticated bounded readback preserve ADR0015 and ADR0016. They neither introduce cryptography nor expose plaintext files, full-object RAM allocation, research-content projections, key escrow or portability/security authority. Required unavailable/quarantined/unknown states, unsafe path substitutions, missing keys and authentication or audit failures deny publication. Deleted/tombstoned semantics are explicitly preserved. Existing construction can invoke migration and known-ID open can update verification/quarantine state; the proposal's compatible identity check before construction and staged-copy-only confinement must remain enforced during implementation, as already stated, with no original reconciliation, repair or migration.

The plan requires a failing staged missing-ciphertext regression after normal legal claim, valid/empty and corrupt/key/state/path/principal/identity/cancellation/concurrent-change denials, affected existing object-store checks, real protected staged readback and expanded independent security/interface review. Actual whole Native/Core termination and fresh restart remain required. Additional future-lineage recognition is limited to this exact admitted/claimed/reviewed T01 source delta with actual owner/addendum/claim/source/candidate/review hashes and independent negative controls before execution. No new architecture/lint/CSP or other predicate exemption is conferred; all original failures remain preserved.

The exact brief reproduces the proposal and supplies the problem, single added path, bounded algorithm, retained criteria/gates, alternatives and recommendation, and explicit approval/resume conditions. The grant covers conforming implementation details only within this finite addition. Original packet/approval bytes and IDs remain immutable. No further framework development, governed UX/baseline/RAM/release change, original-fixture alteration or implicit legacy recovery is requested. Normal B00 admission/review, task claim, security review, integration and release gates remain separate; the active view integrity run is not claimed complete by this readiness record.
